scope_warning: Not full-cohort clustering, benchmark comparison, or ILS evaluation.

implementation_policy.implementation: Python reimplementation; not author-supplied C code
implementation_policy.cluster_selection: largest within-leaf sum of SMD; first-created leaf on a tie
implementation_policy.two_modes_initial_centers: mode of selected leaf and first farthest source row
implementation_policy.updated_categorical_mode_tie: retain previous category if modal; otherwise lexicographic
implementation_policy.farthest_row_tie: first in the preserved source-row order
implementation_policy.identical_leaf: not bisected; select another splittable leaf
implementation_policy.empty_child: move first farthest row from a non-singleton donor, then update modes; logged
implementation_policy.inner_stopping: child memberships unchanged; explicit iteration cap raises an error
implementation_policy.final_kmodes: host care_km.kmodes_fit, unchanged; host tie and empty-cluster rules
implementation_policy.timing_scope: all leaf selection, bisection, and mode construction belong to initialization
implementation_policy.number_of_centers: k leaf modes; coincident leaf modes are reported, not silently deduplicated
implementation_policy.determinism: fixed implementation, string categories, input order, and parameters

cci_dofd: not implemented; fuzzy/weighted protocol requires separate assessment
reuse: reuse implementation; pilot fits are reusable only for identical subset/configuration
outputs_for_next_stage: initial/final modes, memberships, preserved sample indices, split trace
